newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian navy sells shiplift to Transfield.
newsitem.headline: Australian navy sells shiplift to Transfield.

text.p: The Australian Defence Department said on Wednesday it had finalised the sale of its interest in a Western Australian shiplift facility to the unlisted Transfield Defence Systems Pty Ltd.

"(Transfield) exercised its right as the long-term hirer of the equipment to purchase the Western Australian marine support facility on a commercial basis," the department said in a statement. No price was given.
The shiplift facility at Fremantle, south of Perth, was commissioned in 1989 as a joint venture between the department, the state government and state company Australian Shipbuilding Industries.
It can accommodate vessels up to 8,000 tonnes (tons).
